questions.q: How do you shape a journey around us?
questions.a: We begin with your dates, interests, and pace. From there, we discuss a route and refine it with you.

questions.q: How much time should we allow for Sri Lanka?
questions.a: Ten days covers the island's highlights without rushing. Two weeks lets you add the east coast or stay longer where you want to.

questions.q: Can we make the trip work for children?
questions.a: Yes. We shorten the drives, build in pool afternoons, and pick stays with room to spread out.

questions.q: What happens after we get in touch?
questions.a: We reply with a few questions, then send a draft route to react to. Nothing is booked until the plan feels right.

questions.q: Can the route change while we plan?
questions.a: As often as you like. Most itineraries go through two or three rounds before they settle.

questions.q: What is included in a proposed trip?
questions.a: Stays, transport with a driver-guide, entrance fees for the sites you choose, and the day plans. We list anything optional separately.

questions.q: How do we choose the right coast for our dates?
questions.a: The monsoons reach the two coasts at opposite times of year. Tell us your dates and we will point you at the one with the better weather.
